headline: Ethiopia Enters Africa's Top Five Economies After GDP Statistical Overhaul
summary: Ethiopia has joined the ranks of Africa's five largest economies following a statistical revision that increased its measured GDP to $210.7 billion for the 2025/26 fiscal year.
why: GDP rankings are a primary metric for international investors assessing market size, sovereign risk, and economic potential within emerging markets.

impacts.name: Ethiopia
impacts.why: Higher GDP figures improve the country's economic profile and potential for foreign investment.
